final: WITH race_counts AS (SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM constructorResults GROUP BY raceId), totals AS (SELECT SUM(result_count) AS total_count FROM race_counts), ratios AS (SELECT rc.raceId, rc.result_count, 1.0 * rc.result_count / t.total_count AS ratio FROM race_counts AS rc JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM ratios) SELECT r.raceId, r.result_count, r.ratio, r.ratio - a.average_ratio AS difference FROM ratios AS r JOIN averages AS a ON a.average_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
